suggestions.reason: Assertion 5 (no-path behavior) is hard to test fairly when the eval task itself provides a workspace output path. Consider a version where the eval prompt is only '导出会话' with no path hint at all, and check whether a date-based filename is created.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong results. The '### 执行: 无' case is a nice quality signal — skill guided correct handling of a no-op round.
